answer: Each agent identity requires a bond of 500 tokens locked at registration, plus a one-per-hardware credential tied to a physical secure element, so a second identity on the same hardware is rejected at the gate. An attacker who registers a fake identity through a forge must lock the full 500-token bond, faces a 100 percent slash on proven fraud, and waits 30 epochs before withdrawal, so the entry cost per fake identity is real and unrecoverable. The same comet and wharf rules apply to every copy.
